dashboard.title: Where you left off
dashboard.desc: Your saved schemes, anything closing soon, and what has recently been added to the register.
dashboard.searchBlurb: Describe your situation in a sentence.
dashboard.browseBlurb: Start from who you are or what you need.
dashboard.assistantBlurb: Get an answer grounded in the register.
dashboard.savedEmpty: Nothing saved yet. Use the bookmark on any scheme to keep it here while you gather documents.

search.title: Find a scheme
search.desc: Describe your situation in your own words, or narrow the register with the filters. Both work together.
search.placeholder: e.g. loan for a woman starting a small business in Karnataka
search.noResultsDesc: Try fewer filters, or describe your situation in your own words instead.
search.failedDesc: The connection to the scheme service failed. Try the search again in a moment.

categories.title: Start from your situation
categories.desc: Every scheme on the register, grouped by who it was written for.

savedPage.title: Saved schemes
savedPage.desc: The schemes you are working through. Nothing here expires on its own.
savedPage.empty: Nothing saved yet. Use the bookmark on any scheme to keep it here.

checklist.title: Documents
checklist.desc: Everything you need to gather, collected from the schemes you saved.
checklist.empty: No documents yet. Save a scheme and its document list appears here.
checklist.pickSchemeDesc: Open any scheme or search the register to start its document checklist.
checklist.failedDesc: Could not load the document checklist for this scheme.
checklist.noneRecorded: Documents not recorded for this scheme yet
checklist.noneRecordedDesc: The official notification has not recorded specific document requirements.

assistant.title: Ask the assistant
assistant.desc: Ask about any scheme or eligibility rule. Every answer is grounded in the register.
assistant.placeholder: Ask a question about any government scheme…
assistant.hint: Press Enter to send. Every claim is grounded in a scheme record.

profile.title: Your profile
profile.desc: What we know about you, used only to judge which schemes you qualify for.

settings.title: Settings
settings.desc: Language, text size, and what happens to your data.
settings.languageDesc: The whole interface, including the assistant, follows this choice.
settings.textSizeDesc: Larger text throughout, for comfortable reading.

login.title: Pick up where you left off
login.desc: Sign in with your mobile number to open the register. First time here? The same number creates your account — there is nothing separate to sign up for.
login.mobileHint: We send a 6-digit code to this number.
login.errPhone: Enter the 10-digit mobile number registered with you.
login.errSend: We could not send the code. Check the number and try again.
login.errOtp: That code did not match. Request a new one and try again.
login.errPassword: That email and password did not match an account.
login.privacy: We ask for a mobile number only to keep your saved schemes attached to you. You can export or delete everything from Settings at any time.
login.asideTitle: The register, and everything it remembers for you
login.add1: Search every central and state scheme in plain language
login.add2: Keep a list of the schemes you are working through
login.add3: Save your document checklist between visits
login.add4: Get told before a deadline on a saved scheme passes
login.asideFoot: BharatAssist AI never submits an application on your behalf. Government portals stay the only place a form is filed.
